title: Proofs of Some Kanade--Russell Mod 12 Conjectures
summary: Kanade and Russell conjectured seventeen Rogers--Ramanujan type identities of modulus 12. Eleven of these identities involving triple sums were proved by Bringmann--Jennings-Shaffer--Mahlburg and by Rosengren. Motivated by these works and using similar methods, we settle all the six remaining conjectures including two triple sum identities labeled $I_{5a}$ and $I_{6a}$ originated from Russell's thesis and four quadruple sum identities labeled 7, 7a, 8 and 8a. Our proof of the triple sum identities combines linear recurrences, $q$-difference equations, and $q$-series summation formulas. For…
